feature: ApacheJIT data acquisition — download script, gitignore, docs
problem: ApacheJIT CSV files (train, test_large, test_small) are needed locally for feat-2 adapter and feat-3 predictive eval. No download script or Active Data Source entry exists yet.
proposed_solution: Add scripts/download_apachejit.sh mirroring download_bpi2014.sh pattern. Download apachejit_dataset_replication.zip from Zenodo 5907847, extract the three split CSVs from dataset/ into data/apachejit/. Add ApacheJIT under Active Data Sources in docs/datasets.md. Verify data/ gitignore already covers data/apachejit/.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: scripts/download_apachejit.sh exists, is executable (test -x), has shebang #!/usr/bin/env bash, header comment with Usage: ./scripts/download_apachejit.sh [target_dir] and Zenodo record URL, TARGET_DIR="${1:-data/apachejit}", mkdir -p, download() helper with skip-if-exists messaging, and final ls -lh summary — mirroring download_bpi2014.sh structure

AC-2: Script obtains apachejit_train.csv, apachejit_test_large.csv, and apachejit_test_small.csv from Zenodo record 5907847 by downloading apachejit_dataset_replication.zip (https://zenodo.org/api/records/5907847/files/apachejit_dataset_replication.zip/content) and extracting dataset/apachejit_train.csv, dataset/apachejit_test_large.csv, and dataset/apachejit_test_small.csv into flat target_dir (Zenodo does not publish direct per-CSV URLs)

AC-3: Script is idempotent — when all three CSV files already exist in target_dir, exits 0 without re-downloading or re-extracting; when individual files exist, skips only those files and fetches missing ones
AC-4: Script accepts optional target_dir argument (default: data/apachejit)
AC-5: Script uses set -euo pipefail and curl -fSL (same safety as BPI script)
AC-6: data/apachejit/ is covered by existing .gitignore data/ entry — git check-ignore -q data/apachejit/apachejit_train.csv exits 0 from repo root; do not add redundant data/apachejit/ line

AC-7: docs/datasets.md has a ### ApacheJIT subsection under ## Active Data Sources (after BPI Challenge 2014, before Synthetic Fixtures) containing: Zenodo link (https://zenodo.org/records/5907847), the three CSV file names, download command (scripts/download_apachejit.sh), data path (data/apachejit/), **What it covers:** bullet list, and **What it lacks:** bullet list — matching BPI Active Data Source format

AC-8: Active Data Source entry includes a | Metric | Value | table with at minimum: Total commits (~106K), Bug-inducing positives (~28K), Splits (train 2003–2016 balanced; test_large 2017+ unbalanced; test_small subset of test_large), Label method (SZZ + JIRA + GumTree), Tier (B)
AC-9: Script runs successfully end-to-end on a clean target_dir: exits 0 and leaves all three CSV files present

AC-10: Each downloaded CSV has a non-empty header line containing buggy column name and data row count (wc -l minus 1) of at least 1,000 for apachejit_train.csv and apachejit_test_small.csv and at least 10,000 for apachejit_test_large.csv
AC-11: No adapter logic implemented — only download script and documentation changes
AC-12: No changes to src/ or tests/ directories (git diff --name-only src/ tests/ is empty after implementation)
edge_cases: EC-1: Zenodo URL returns 404 or is rate-limited — script fails with non-zero exit and curl error on stderr (set -e + curl -f), not silently producing empty or partial files

EC-2: Partial download (user interrupts mid-curl or mid-unzip) — re-run completes missing files; note: no checksum validation at P0 (document as limitation in script comment or docs if extraction fails on corrupt zip)
EC-3: data/ directory doesn't exist yet — script creates it via mkdir -p before downloading

EC-4: Zenodo publishes only apachejit_dataset_replication.zip, not standalone CSVs — script must handle zip download and extraction (unzip or equivalent); missing unzip/unar must fail with clear error, not silent skip
EC-5: Zip already downloaded but CSVs not yet extracted — script extracts missing CSVs without re-downloading the zip when zip is present and intact
verification_method: test -x scripts/download_apachejit.sh. Run script on clean data/apachejit/ (or tmp dir). Assert exit 0 and three CSVs exist. wc -l on each CSV; head -1 checks buggy header. git check-ignore -q data/apachejit/apachejit_train.csv. grep Active Data Sources section in docs/datasets.md for ### ApacheJIT, metrics table, What it covers/lacks. git diff --name-only src/ tests/ must be empty.
